actions.description: Grants permission to configure a response that executes once your budget exceeds a specific budget threshold. Creating a budget action with tags also requires the 'budgets:TagResource' permission
actions.name: CreateBudgetAction

actions.description: Grants permission to delete an action that is associated with a specific budget
actions.name: DeleteBudgetAction

actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve the details of a specific budget action associated with a budget
actions.name: DescribeBudgetAction

actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve a historical view of the budget actions statuses associated with a particular budget action. These status include statues such as 'Standby', 'Pending' and 'Executed'
actions.name: DescribeBudgetActionHistories

actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve the details of all of the budget actions associated with your account
actions.name: DescribeBudgetActionsForAccount

actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve the details of all of the budget actions associated with a budget
actions.name: DescribeBudgetActionsForBudget

actions.description: Grants permission to initiate a pending budget action as well as reverse a previously executed budget action
actions.name: ExecuteBudgetAction

actions.description: Grants permission to view resource tags for a budget or budget action
actions.name: ListTagsForResource

actions.description: Grants permission to create and modify budgets, and edit budget details. Creating a budget with tags also requires the 'budgets:TagResource' permission
actions.name: ModifyBudget

actions.description: Grants permission to apply resource tags to a budget or budget action. Also needed to create a budget or budget action with tags
actions.name: TagResource

actions.description: Grants permission to remove resource tags from a budget or budget action
actions.name: UntagResource

actions.description: Grants permission to update the details of a specific budget action associated with a budget
actions.name: UpdateBudgetAction

actions.description: Grants permission to view budgets and budget details
actions.name: ViewBudget
